name: Puzzle eval: Terra and DeepSeek Flash beat Luna at similar cost
title: Puzzle eval: Terra and DeepSeek Flash beat Luna at similar cost
summary: On 50 fresh puzzles, Terra solved all 50 in 1.66 steps for about $1.30 and DeepSeek Flash solved all 50 in 2.06 steps for $0.96, versus Luna at 38 solved, 6.24 steps, and about $1. Opus 5.5 solved all 50 in 1.30 steps for about $19, while Kimi solved 34 in 7.32 steps for about $12.
